sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.3 Consumer and Share Consumer Configs
Apache Kafka 4.3 Design: Message Delivery Semantics and Using Transactions
Reproducible processed-event, outbox and retry state-model test

claims.text: Kafka 4.3 documents idempotent producer semantics for producer retries and that configuring transactional.id enables transactional delivery with idempotence; the candidate explicitly limits this guarantee to Kafka transport/transaction boundaries.
Kafka 4.3 consumer documentation states that read_committed returns only committed transactional messages and can stop at the Last Stable Offset while a transaction remains open.

Kafka 4.3 design documentation separates Kafka transactional exactly-once processing from destination-storage cooperation. The candidate therefore does not claim that Kafka transactions atomically include arbitrary business databases or third-party APIs.

Stable event IDs, a database transaction covering processed-event state, business state and outbox, downstream idempotency, retention, observability, rollout and SLO inputs are explicit design requirements in the candidate rather than claims about a deployed production system.

The executable model verifies that duplicate delivery after a committed business effect but before offset acknowledgement does not create a second business/outbox record, and that an outbox retry retains the same downstream event ID after an ambiguous send. The candidate explicitly treats real database transaction/unique-constraint semantics and downstream contracts as production prerequisites.

findings: 本轮先按候选答案中的 Kafka 断言重新核对 Kafka 4.3 producer、consumer 与 Design 官方文档，再检查历史 revise 缺口；未发现把 Kafka 事务错误外推到任意外部数据库/API 的事实问题。
此前缺少场景输入/SLO 边界的问题已收口：候选明确要求峰值/积压、延迟、RPO/RTO、重放窗口和外部幂等能力；2 万条/秒与 30 天仅作为容量计算示例，不冒充真实生产指标。
3 分钟版已压缩为语义边界、主状态机、下游 outbox、Kafka 边界和验收/灰度五段，保留故障注入与可观测性闭环，来源问法完整覆盖。
